title: Hearty Crispy Malaysian Pastry Tart
description: A festive, dairy‑free tart featuring a ready‑rolled shortcrust pastry shell filled with a spicy curry‑saiway namul vegetable mixture and tofu, served crisp on a tagliere.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the ready‑rolled shortcrust pastry onto a clean work surface and roll it out to fit a 9‑inch tagliere, trimming the edges to leave a small rim.

In a small saucepan combine the coconut milk, curry paste, ground coriander, ground cumin, turmeric, soy sauce and maple syrup; stir until the mixture is smooth and let it simmer for 2 minutes to meld the flavors.
While the sauce simmers sauté the blanched namul vegetables and cubed tofu in a splash of coconut oil until the tofu is golden and the vegetables fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Toss the sautéed vegetables and tofu with the simmered curry sauce, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste, and let the mixture cool slightly.
Spoon the vegetable‑curry filling evenly into the pastry shell, pressing it in gently with the back of a spoon so it adheres to the dough.
Brush the edges of the pastry with a little coconut milk to seal them and prevent puffing during baking.
Slide the prepared tart onto the preheated baking sheet and bake for 18–20 minutes, or until the pastry turns golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove the tart from the oven, allow it to cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes, then transfer it to the tagliere for serving.
Slice the tart into wedges, garnish with fresh cilantro leaves if desired, and serve warm or at room temperature.
